title: Manifest of an extension, theme, app or snippet
description: The manifest.json file at the root of the item's folder. The rules specific to each kind (required main file, folder name, files present) are checked by tools/validate.py. See docs/extensions/manifest.md.

id.description: Stable id, in lowercase. Must be the folder name.

main.description: Main script, at the root of the folder. Required for an extension and an app.

type.description: How main is run: classic script (default) or ES module, which can import the .js and .mjs files of its folder with a relative path.

colors.description: File of the color schemes, for a theme.

defaultScheme.description: Name of the colors.ini section used by default.

resources.description: XAML resource dictionary, for a theme or a snippet.

icon.description: SVG icon for the sidebar, for an app.

tags.description: Short lowercase words (dark, layout, glass, lyrics...) that the Marketplace shows on the card.

preview.description: Preview image for the Marketplace, at the root of the folder. 2 MB at most.

settings.description: Settings of an extension or a theme, shown in the Ampify card of Apple Music's settings. An extension reads them with Ampify.config.get(key); a theme's user.css with var(--setting-<key>) and @setting blocks.

processes.description: Process where the item runs: ui (AppleMusic.exe), engine (AMPLibraryAgent.exe). Both by default.

appVersions.description: Apple Music versions the item is tested on. The kernel also applies its own list.

translations.description: Name and description in the languages Ampify speaks (fr only for now). Shown instead of the English ones when Windows is in that language.

settings.description: The label of each declared setting, by its key.

options.description: The text of each option of a choice setting, by its stored value.

default.description: true or false for a toggle, one of the options for a choice, a text, or a number.
